benefits.description: Identify Eltern-Kind-Pass examinations and the administrative connection between documented examination evidence and Kinderbetreuungsgeld. Do not choose examinations or interpret results.

scope.description: For this overview and local-service lookup no application documents need to be collected. State that a later selected application gets its own sourced, circumstance-specific checklist; do not request financial or medical records for orientation.
